description: Search the text of every document postalref holds for the pages that say the words, best first: those that say them as a phrase, then by how much of the page they are and how many of them it says side by side or close together, a table of contents last, and at most three pages a document. A page needn't have the words a question asks with, such as how, get or take. Each word is found in its forms, and a name also as the registry's other names for it, BCG for Business Customer Gateway or Post Office Box for PO Box, and a size as 4x6 or 4 x 6; a hit another wording found gives it as `by`. Each hit gives the id and page read_source reads, and the passage that says most of the words. Use it when no title names what you're looking for, as for a price in the Mail Classification Schedule or a rule in a DMM chapter. A hit's `context` is a whole sentence, list or row of the page unless it starts or ends with …: quote it with the hit's `id` and `page`, or read_source them for the sentences around it. When no hit answers, search again with the words an answer would say.

limit.description: At most this many pages; 10 when absent.

query.description: Words a page says: a price, a rule, a size, a name. Each word is found in its forms: one or many, -ed, -ing, -able, -ous.

name: search_text
title: Search the text of documents
